authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6141 dadāti describes the development of the de- present stem and explicitly supplies Punjabi deṇā, Bengali deoyā, Oriya debā, Maithili deb, Hindi denā and Gujarati devũ. Selected simple de- giving responses preserve their elicited infinitive, finite and regional l-endings; no compound response is reduced to its first verb. The local Indo-Aryan transmission route is unresolved. The unrelated cutting verb at 6257 is not used. Exact response: dena.
